cohort: The study included 1,107 women who underwent primary anterior colporrhaphy and 577 women who underwent primary posterior colporrhaphy between September 2012 and September 2013.
finding: Slowly absorbable sutures were associated with a significantly lower rate of symptomatic recurrence and higher patient satisfaction 1 year after anterior colporrhaphy compared to rapidly absorbable sutures, although urgency improved more in the rapidly absorbable suture group, while no significant difference was found for posterior colporrhaphy.
